callback_scope: global allocator callbacks after System returns; process-wide across threads; excludes RSS, object-owned memory, allocator-internal realloc overlap, and latency
ownership_scope: phase labels describe retained handles at callback-order boundaries; live bytes are process-global allocator counters and are not object-retention measurements

phases.label: baseline_before_inputs
phases.live_owners: region acquired; corpus bytes remain outside the lifecycle; no input clones or sink

phases.label: prepared_inputs_and_sink
phases.live_owners: owned source and destination input Vec clones, bounded sink, and reserved sink capacity

phases.label: opened_documents
phases.live_owners: owned source and destination Packages plus their opened presentation handles

phases.label: planned
phases.live_owners: opened source/destination handles and the validated cross-copy plan

phases.label: published
phases.live_owners: opened packages, plan, publication result, and sink containing the exact output

phases.label: drop_result
phases.live_owners: opened packages, plan, and exact output sink after the publication result is released

phases.label: drop_plan
phases.live_owners: opened packages and exact output sink after the plan is released

phases.label: drop_document_handles
phases.live_owners: exact output sink remains after source and destination Packages and opened handles are released

phases.label: drop_sink
phases.live_owners: no lifecycle-owned input, document, plan, publication result, or sink handles; process baseline may differ
